cards.title: Introduction to Python Security
cards.content: Security is paramount in software development. Python developers must be aware of common vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection, Insecure Deserialization, and XSS. Writing secure code ensures user data protection and application integrity.

cards.title: Using Environment Variables
cards.content:
Never hardcode sensitive information like API keys or database passwords in your Python source code.

import os
api_key = os.getenv("API_KEY")
